property_summary: For any clone-style calldata whose trailing immutable args are owner, collateral, debt, factory, C.owner() returns the address at args offset 0x0 (the owner); the mutant reads offset 0x28 and returns the debt token address instead, differing whenever owner != debt.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x28 (debt token address) instead of 0x0, so owner() returns the debt token address.
